name: What size shower works best in a small Los Angeles bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What shower size or configuration is most practical for a tight bathroom layout?
mainEntity.text: What shower size or configuration is most practical for a tight bathroom layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right shower size depends on how much room is left after accounting for the toilet, vanity, and door clearance. In tight bathrooms, a compact walk-in shower can improve the feeling of openness, especially if it uses clear glass and a simple layout. A shower-tub combo can still make sense if the home needs flexibility for resale or family use. The biggest mistake is choosing a shower that looks nice on paper but makes the room feel cramped in real life. Homeowners should ask for a dimensioned layout before approving the design, because a few inches can make a major difference in comfort and code compliance. The most practical design is the one that balances shower comfort with circulation and storage.
acceptedAnswer.description: In a small bathroom, a compact walk-in shower or a well-sized shower-tub combination often works better than a bulky enclosure. The best choice depends on clearance, door swing, and whether the room needs storage or circulation more than a larger shower footprint.
